Type.evidence_source: Data analysis was led by the female researcher who conducted the interviews and a male principal investigator for the broader study.

Area.evidence_source: The objective of this study was to describe the underpinnings of rural men's depression and suicide through analysis of participants' reflections on the event and aftermath of losing a male to suicide. ... agreement was reached on the codes which included factors underlying men's depression and suicide, reactions to the news of the suicide, and suggestions for male suicide prevention. ... three inductively and deductively derived themes—(1) hiding depression and its cause, (b) manly self-medicating, and (c) mobilizing prevention—were developed
